segments.text: The police officers stood on their heads trying to wring some statement out of that killer. They could not get even a single letter written down. segments.text: Before that smile had faded, strikes arose across the country. The Tsar's government could not shoot the strike down. The government floundered. For eight months the strike lived victoriously. It was the time when Russia, having fought Japan, surrendered. The people spat at Tsarist rule. The revolution grew. In 1906 the ‘Duma’ met. In a dark room, with both eyes shut,
those who say the people of the world keep rolling—
let ignorance sink! To make that understood
Periyar's drum-sound thundered.
Along that path came he...beloved...comrade,
dear Selvam......warrior of the movement of reason.
In the sun's good light,
darkness withdrew, saying its time was done;
there...
the morning sun that rose in the east,
if it suddenly fell...into the sea,
would not the world be shaken? Would it not wither and waste away!
Just as this land moved forward to cast off darkness and gain light,
delusion-shrouded death-madness
hid the young ray!
